answer_1.quote: We validate our approach on multiple sequence generation tasks. For neural machine translation, we train our model from scratch. For other tasks, we first perform pre‑training... We use the GLGE benchmark to evaluate BART‑JANUS on sequence generation tasks, selecting XSum (abstractive text summarization), SQuAD 1.1 (answer‑aware question generation), and PersonaChat (conversational question answering).
answer_1.outputs: translations, summaries, generated questions, dialog responses

answer_2.quote: We report test set performance by measuring BLEU. For XSum we present results with ROUGE‑1, ROUGE‑2, ROUGE‑L, METEOR. For PersonaChat we also report Distinct‑1 and Distinct‑2 scores.
